title: Residential pricing, 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027
archive_note: Text of the page with all panels expanded. Rate tables machine-readable in the source.
establishes: 2026-27 residential water usage 3.41/kL and drought usage 3.84/kL, with the 60/70 storage trigger stated
Metered water service charge 26.65 per quarter, accrued daily over a 90, 91 or 92 day quarter
Wastewater service charge 189.88 per quarter, a fixed charge already containing a deemed usage component — so Sydney's total water services does not rest on a property valuation
A published reconciliation: 26.65 + 50 x 3.41 + 189.88 = 387.03, the publisher's own typical quarterly bill
That stormwater is not part of the publisher's typical residential bundle
does_not_establish: Which usage rate is in force. The page gives both rates and links to a storage figure it does not reproduce. The difference is 12.6% of the usage charge.

The retail trigger mechanics. WaterNSW's bulk pricing documents a 31-day lag under Part 7 Clause 25 of that determination; this retail page states the trigger without one. The two determinations must not be conflated.
The GST treatment: Commonwealth statute, see antsa-gst-act-38-285.
